name: inbox_write
description: Put code that came from outside (pasted in the chat, copied from a web page, sent by someone) into the Sandbox as a FILE, exactly as given, instead of typing it there: typing several lines into a Sandbox console breaks easily. The text is written unchanged (UTF-8, the line breaks as given) into the shared inbox, which the Sandbox sees read-only; a few seconds later it is in the Sandbox desktop folder Input, checked against its SHA-256 (Desktop\input-check.html shows OK or FAIL). Then run that file in the Sandbox with one short command (e.g. python "%USERPROFILE%\Desktop\Input\main.py"). Nothing is opened or run on this computer. Do not fix, decode or reformat the code first. At most 256 KiB.

name.description: File name with the right extension for the language, no folder part (e.g. main.py, script.sh, run.ps1, hello.js).

annotations.title: Write pasted code into the Sandbox inbox as a file
